notes: Synchronized calibration and status LEDs. Calibration is now one session owned by the scale (zero, wait for an explicit confirmation from the screen OR the web page, measure from raw HX711 conversions, save, read back, verify; the previous factor is restored on any failure) and never blocks BLE or weight reading. Every calibration message fits a single BLE notification at the default 23-byte MTU. The LED patterns and charger reporting are included in the source but switched off in this release (they need a bench measurement of the shared TP4056 circuit first).
